qwen.quantization: 4-bit NF4 double-quantized base, emulated (quantize->dequantize round trip of every base Linear except lm_head; bitsandbytes has no Apple-silicon backend). Base frozen in fp16; LoRA weights fp32.
qwen.prompt: local_reranker.classification_prompt (byte-identical to the notebook serving prompt)
qwen.target: {"label":"X"} appended after the prompt, as in the notebook
qwen.loss: completion-only (prompt tokens masked). The historical run used full-text loss.
qwen.truncation: never truncates the label: prompts longer than max_length have the description, then bullet points, shortened until prompt+target fit
qwen.length_grouping: shuffled mega-batches of 64 rows sorted by length (padding efficiency)
qwen.selection: checkpoint with the higher VALIDATION macro-F1 on validation_pairs (ties -> later checkpoint)
